claim: The shadcn CLI is monorepo-aware via a components.json per workspace and routes shared components into the ui package, but the documented setup is Turborepo — Nx is not covered.
quote: The CLI now understands the monorepo structure and will install the components, dependencies and registry dependencies to the correct paths and handle imports for you. Every workspace must have a components.json file.

claim: In Nx, shadcn init fails without TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.base.json, generated components use path aliases that Nx module-boundary lint dislikes, and library styles must be injected into the app.
quote: Generated components use path aliases for cross-component imports, which is not optimal in Nx, but I haven't found any way how to change this.

claim: shadcn components placed in a shared Nx lib render unstyled under Tailwind v4 because the app's Tailwind build does not scan the library source by default.
quote: ShadCN UI styles not working in Nx Monorepo with Tailwind v4 and Next.js 15 — shared UI components and styles in libs/ui, styles aren't applying when importing components.

claim: An Nx plugin exists that generates shadcn/ui components into Nx libraries and supports Nx 21 and later.
quote: An Nx plugin for working with shadcn/ui. Nx >= 21 <= 23 || ^22.0.0-0

claim: shadcn supports running a private/custom registry to distribute your own components, hooks, config and rules to any project via the CLI — the update channel for copy-in code.
quote: Run your own code registry to distribute your custom components, hooks, pages, config, rules and other files to any project.

claim: MUI barrel imports significantly slow dev startup and rebuilds; icon named imports can be up to 6x slower than path imports; the fix is deep path imports enforced with no-restricted-imports.
quote: Barrel imports like @mui/material or @mui/icons-material can cause significantly slower startup and rebuild times... named imports can be up to six times slower than default path-based imports.

claim: Emotion adds roughly 21.2 kB minified to the bundle; Mantine no longer recommends it for new projects, using CSS Modules instead since v7.
quote: the bundle will include @emotion/react (21.2kB minified), @mantine/emotion (~2kb minified) and all styles used in components... Emotion is not recommended for new projects.

claim: Mantine's CSS Modules approach needs no 'use client' directives for styling and aligns with RSC, whereas MUI's Emotion runtime requires client components.
quote: Mantine's CSS Modules approach is the most aligned with the React Server Components model today, with no "use client" directives needed for styling.

claim: Nx 21 recommends package-manager workspaces plus TypeScript project references over tsconfig path aliases; typecheck memory drops 6.14 GB to 945 MB and cached typecheck 186s to 25s.
quote: Initial run: Memory drops from 6.14 GB to 945 MB. Cached runs: Typecheck improves from 186 seconds to 25 seconds.

claim: As of July 2026 shadcn init defaults to Base UI rather than Radix for new projects.
quote: As of July 2026, shadcn/ui defaults to Base UI for new projects — but Radix is not deprecated.
